Extend the offline evaluation from predictive discrimination to warning timeliness:
- At the frozen operating point, compare model and baseline warning lead times and alert volumes using the same eligible customers, observation windows, and counting rules.
fail.reason: The owner's task already has a full judge and says to keep its scope, methods, and acceptance conditions unchanged. Instead of returning it unchanged or repairing only a concrete defect, the response adds an extra analysis (lead-time and alert-volume diagnostics) and a new causal-falsification method. It also claims all three lenses fit ('Skipped lenses: None'). This manufactures contributions through added analyses, which the case explicitly disallows.
